title: The Microsoft Call That Needs a New Record in 24 Days
speaker: tastylive 'Signal vs. Noise' host

macro_themes.view: Toshiba plans to double hard-drive supply in 2027 and memory names have repriced, so Micron puts may be a relative-value short or a hedge.
Nasdaq is breaking out with the Mag 7 on top; MSFT price targets are being raised after its best quarter since 1998.

calls.condition: Flow-based: ~$28M in Jan 1050/1070 puts; may be a hedge or part of a spread
calls.reason: Large near-the-money January puts appeared right after a record quarter that the stock did not reward; host notes it could be a hedge by a long holder.
calls.quote: Someone willing to put down $28 million into Micron ... saying that they're already reflected in the price

calls.condition: Needs a new record high through Oct 30 earnings for the 570 calls to pay
calls.reason: $6.3M of fresh Oct 30 570 and Nov 13 540 calls spanning earnings; strong momentum above its moving averages and a run of price-target raises.
calls.quote: Microsoft has really strong price momentum right now, and someone suggesting that this thing could run up into new all-time highs

notes: Date not spoken. Inferred as 2026-10-06 from DTE math: Oct 30 at 24 DTE, Nov 13 at 38 DTE, Jan 15 at 101 DTE all imply Oct 6 (listing approx_date 10-07). 'January 27th 1050 put' is read as the January 2027 expiry. MU price not stated; the 954.90 break-even is said to be ~10% below the current price (so ~1,060). Biases describe the options flow, which the host treats as 'reasonably expected' rather than as his own call. The 954.90 MU 'target' is the put buyer's break-even.
